title: Cult world?
content: I went to mall world in my dream last night, I was in the ghetto part that reminds me of Mexico, I was talking to someone and we joked about how this place seems like a cult and is giving off cult vibes, I’m trying to figure out what we meant by that but if it was you or if you ever joked and called mall world cult world lmk so I won’t think I’m so crazy for going to mall world almost every time I sleep
